messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: I can’t refund the trail running shoes yet because our records don’t show that we’ve received them back. We refund items only after they’re recorded as returned (refund-policy/v1/return). If you’ve already sent them, let me know and I can ask a staff member to check.
I haven’t sent them back yet.
